name: Generate Income Tax Block Depreciation (WDV)
description: Computes and posts annual block-wise Income Tax WDV depreciation per FAM_DEP_RATE_IT_MASTER block. ASSUMPTIONS (no user available to confirm - see OPEN QUESTIONS): (1) This process reads INCOME_TAX_BLOCK_CODE, TOTAL_CAPITALIZED_COST and BRANCH_CODE on FAM_ASSET_REGISTER. A capitalized asset is identified via CAPITALIZATION_DATE IS NOT NULL. (2) ASSESSMENT_YEAR criterion is the calendar year in which the financial year ENDS (e.g. 2026 = FY 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31). (3) BRANCH_CODE narrows which assets' additions/disposals are counted (a filter), not a grouping dimension - output stays one row per BLOCK_CODE. (4) The FRS workflow (Generate/Edit/Submit-for-approval/Approve & Post/Cancel) is approximated within General Process capabilities: Generate = run + preview grid (execution_mode edit), the user edits REMARKS and STATUS (DRAFT/PENDING_APPROVAL/APPROVED/CANCELLED), Execute persists the row - setting STATUS=APPROVED is the 'Approve & Post' action, after which CLOSING_WDV becomes next year's OPENING_WDV for the same block. (5) 'Period cannot be re-generated once posted' is enforced by an ALREADY_POSTED S-calc plus a blocking validation. (6) LEGACY BLOCK OPENING WDV BASELINE: FAM_DEP_RATE_IT_MASTER carries OPENING_WDV (NUMBER, the block's aggregate legacy WDV) and OPENING_WDV_AS_ON_DATE (DATE, optional) for a block that already existed with its own pooled WDV before this system went live. The bootstrap-fallback baseline (used only when no prior posted assessment year exists for the block) = the block's OPENING_WDV once the assessment year's financial-year-start falls after OPENING_WDV_AS_ON_DATE, else 0.0. SOURCE_SQL / CALCULATIONS SPLIT (current): already_posted and opening_wdv - and everything computed from opening_wdv (net_block, dep_base_full, dep_amount_raw, depreciation_amount, closing_wdv, stcg_amount, remarks) - live in the calculations[] array as S/E calc entries, NOT in source_sql. already_posted and opening_wdv are S-type calc entries whose SQL text references the process's own target table fam_dep_income_tax_block (self-referencing 'already posted' guard + prior assessment-year closing_wdv carry-forward, with the legacy-block baseline above as the opening_wdv fallback); this structured-S-calc placement IS what the engine's self-reference detector (backend/app/services/genprocess/service.py::_self_referencing_target, a case-insensitive regex over S-calc calc_expression text / builtin-validation table fields) scans for, and it correctly makes run_pipeline call table_persist.ensure_target_table() to pre-create the empty target table on every Refresh - this part of the mechanism was verified working. RESOLVED BUG (root cause of the 'relation ... does not exist' failure seen even after this restructuring - matches the reported psycopg2.errors.UndefinedTable relation "fam_dep_income_tax_block" does not exist): target_table/the self-reference SQL had been written in UPPER CASE (FAM_DEP_INCOME_TAX_BLOCK). This project's Postgres DB deploys/folds all identifiers to lower case; table_persist._create_table_sql() quotes target_table VERBATIM (preserving whatever case the model gives it), so an upper-case target_table produced a quoted, case-preserved table literally named "FAM_DEP_INCOME_TAX_BLOCK" - while every unquoted reference to it (this S-calc's SQL text, and table_persist._existing_columns()'s own information_schema lookup, which lower()s the name before comparing) resolves/folds to lower-case fam_dep_income_tax_block and so never finds that object. The pre-create WAS firing on every Refresh; it just kept creating a same-looking-but-different-cased table that nothing else could see, reproducing an identical-looking 'relation does not exist' error on the very next line that reads it. FIX: target_table and every self-reference in the S-calc SQL text are now lower_case (fam_dep_income_tax_block), matching this project's deployed casing convention (see all other real tables here, e.g. fam_asset_register, fam_dep_rate_it_master) - now CREATE TABLE and every unquoted reference resolve to the SAME physical relation; this also resolves the dependent fam_dep_ca_period_detail / fam_dep_it_block_context visuals and the fam_asset_depreciation_reconciliation dashboard, which SELECT from these same lower-case table names. Every column that does NOT depend on opening_wdv (rate_pct, additions_180_days_or_more, additions_less_than_180_days, disposals_during_year, gross_block_opening, gross_block_disposals, gross_block_additions, gross_block_closing, plus the constant literal status) stays computed directly in source_sql's base/step2 CTEs, unaffected by this change.
source_sql: WITH params AS (SELECT CAST(?.assessment_year.number AS INTEGER) AS ay, make_date(CAST(?.assessment_year.number AS INTEGER) - 1, 4, 1) AS fy_start, make_date(CAST(?.assessment_year.number AS INTEGER), 3, 31) AS fy_end, make_date(CAST(?.assessment_year.number AS INTEGER) - 1, 10, 3) AS cutoff_180), eligible_assets AS (SELECT ar.ASSET_CODE AS asset_code, ar.INCOME_TAX_BLOCK_CODE AS block_code, CAST(ar.TOTAL_CAPITALIZED_COST AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS total_capitalized_cost, COALESCE(inst.confirmed_install_date, ar.CAPITALIZATION_DATE) AS put_to_use_date FROM FAM_ASSET_REGISTER ar LEFT JOIN (SELECT ASSET_CODE, MIN(INSTALLATION_DATE) AS confirmed_install_date FROM FAM_ASSET_INSTALLATION WHERE STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' GROUP BY ASSET_CODE) inst ON inst.ASSET_CODE = ar.ASSET_CODE WHERE ar.CAPITALIZATION_DATE IS NOT NULL AND ar.ASSET_TYPE = 'FIXED_ASSET' AND ar.INCOME_TAX_BLOCK_CODE IS NOT NULL AND (?.block_code.string = 'ALL' OR ar.INCOME_TAX_BLOCK_CODE = ?.block_code.string) AND (?.branch_code.string = 'ALL' OR ar.BRANCH_CODE = ?.branch_code.string)), block_additions AS (SELECT ea.block_code AS block_code, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ea.put_to_use_date BETWEEN p.fy_start AND p.cutoff_180 THEN ea.total_capitalized_cost ELSE 0.0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS additions_180_days_or_more, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ea.put_to_use_date > p.cutoff_180 AND ea.put_to_use_date <= p.fy_end THEN ea.total_capitalized_cost ELSE 0.0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS additions_less_than_180_days FROM eligible_assets ea CROSS JOIN params p WHERE ea.put_to_use_date BETWEEN p.fy_start AND p.fy_end GROUP BY ea.block_code), block_disposals AS (SELECT ea.block_code AS block_code, CAST(SUM(CAST(d.SALE_VALUE AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS disposal_proceeds FROM FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL d JOIN eligible_assets ea ON ea.asset_code = d.ASSET_CODE CROSS JOIN params p WHERE d.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND d.DISPOSAL_DATE BETWEEN p.fy_start AND p.fy_end GROUP BY ea.block_code), block_gross_opening AS (SELECT ea.block_code AS block_code, CAST(SUM(ea.total_capitalized_cost) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS gross_block_opening FROM eligible_assets ea CROSS JOIN params p WHERE ea.put_to_use_date < p.fy_start AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL d WHERE d.ASSET_CODE = ea.asset_code AND d.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND d.DISPOSAL_DATE < p.fy_start) GROUP BY ea.block_code), block_gross_disposals AS (SELECT ar.INCOME_TAX_BLOCK_CODE AS block_code, CAST(SUM(CAST(ar.TOTAL_CAPITALIZED_COST AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS gross_block_disposals FROM FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL d JOIN FAM_ASSET_REGISTER ar ON ar.ASSET_CODE = d.ASSET_CODE CROSS JOIN params p WHERE d.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND d.DISPOSAL_DATE BETWEEN p.fy_start AND p.fy_end AND ar.ASSET_TYPE = 'FIXED_ASSET' AND ar.INCOME_TAX_BLOCK_CODE IS NOT NULL AND (?.block_code.string = 'ALL' OR ar.INCOME_TAX_BLOCK_CODE = ?.block_code.string) AND (?.branch_code.string = 'ALL' OR ar.BRANCH_CODE = ?.branch_code.string) GROUP BY ar.INCOME_TAX_BLOCK_CODE), base AS (SELECT p.ay AS assessment_year, rt.BLOCK_CODE AS block_code, rt.BLOCK_DESCRIPTION AS block_description, ?.branch_code.string AS branch_code_filter, p.fy_start AS fy_start, rt.OPENING_WDV AS block_opening_wdv, rt.OPENING_WDV_AS_ON_DATE AS block_opening_wdv_as_on_date, CAST(COALESCE((SELECT r2.RATE_PCT FROM FAM_DEP_RATE_IT_MASTER r2 WHERE r2.BLOCK_CODE = rt.BLOCK_CODE AND r2.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DATE <= p.fy_start ORDER BY r2.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DATE DESC LIMIT 1), 0.0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS rate_pct, COALESCE(ba.additions_180_days_or_more, 0.0) AS additions_180_days_or_more, COALESCE(ba.additions_less_than_180_days, 0.0) AS additions_less_than_180_days, COALESCE(bd.disposal_proceeds, 0.0) AS disposals_during_year, COALESCE(bgo.gross_block_opening, 0.0) AS gross_block_opening, COALESCE(bgd.gross_block_disposals, 0.0) AS gross_block_disposals FROM FAM_DEP_RATE_IT_MASTER rt CROSS JOIN params p LEFT JOIN block_additions ba ON ba.block_code = rt.BLOCK_CODE LEFT JOIN block_disposals bd ON bd.block_code = rt.BLOCK_CODE LEFT JOIN block_gross_opening bgo ON bgo.block_code = rt.BLOCK_CODE LEFT JOIN block_gross_disposals bgd ON bgd.block_code = rt.BLOCK_CODE WHERE (?.block_code.string = 'ALL' OR rt.BLOCK_CODE = ?.block_code.string)), step2 AS (SELECT b.*, (b.additions_180_days_or_more + b.additions_less_than_180_days) AS gross_block_additions, (b.gross_block_opening + (b.additions_180_days_or_more + b.additions_less_than_180_days) - b.gross_block_disposals) AS gross_block_closing FROM base b) SELECT s.assessment_year, s.block_code, s.block_description, s.branch_code_filter, s.fy_start, s.block_opening_wdv, s.block_opening_wdv_as_on_date, s.rate_pct, s.additions_180_days_or_more, s.additions_less_than_180_days, s.disposals_during_year, s.gross_block_opening, s.gross_block_additions, s.gross_block_disposals, s.gross_block_closing, 'DRAFT' AS status FROM step2 s

calculations.calc_expression: select CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fam_dep_income_tax_block t WHERE t.assessment_year = ? AND t.block_code = ? AND t.status = 'APPROVED') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END : assessment_year,block_code

select COALESCE((SELECT t2.closing_wdv FROM fam_dep_income_tax_block t2 WHERE t2.assessment_year = ? - 1 AND t2.block_code = ? AND t2.status = 'APPROVED'), CASE WHEN NULLIF(?, '') IS NOT NULL AND ? > NULLIF(?, '') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(?, '')::numeric, 0.0) ELSE 0.0 END) : assessment_year,block_code,block_opening_wdv_as_on_date,fy_start,block_opening_wdv_as_on_date,block_opening_wdv
if((opening_wdv + additions_180_days_or_more - disposals_during_year) > 0.0, opening_wdv + additions_180_days_or_more - disposals_during_year, 0.0)
if(net_block < 0.0, 'Block ceased to exist during the year - Short Term Capital Gain arises (refer STCG_AMOUNT)', '')
